summary: The longer a worker sits without a job between jobs, the lower the pay on the next job and the longer that gap in pay lasts.
realLife: A study with Census Bureau researchers found earnings outcomes after changing jobs varied mainly with how long the person was jobless, and those with joblessness moved to lower-paying firms.
sources: NBER working paper w29187, Job Displacement and Job Mobility: The Role of Joblessness: https://www.nber.org/papers/w29187
inGame: job-ended event date and the new job record's start date give the gap; pay on the new record carries the effect.

turns.summary: A worker with a lead in hand starts the next job within weeks and keeps pay close to before.
pulledBy: coworker or friend with a lead
turns.writesBack: new job record, similar pay; tie to the lead closer

turns.summary: After months out, the worker takes a smaller employer's job.
turns.writesBack: new job record, lower pay; mood: deflated

turns.summary: A long gap ends in a training program tied to a new field.
